name: glowing-route-lines
title: Glowing Route Lines
description: Three thin route lines with rounded corners enter from the frame edges; on each, a short stretch of the line draws and travels along it while a soft glow capsule rides ahead, aligned to the path, on a loop.
useWhen: Delivery, logistics or route copy needs a calm, looping line background with moving highlights.
A section needs a subtle technical backdrop behind a headline.
avoidWhen: You need a real map or a labelled route: use flight-route-map.
The background must be completely still.
author: GreenSock

variables.description: Colour of the drawn line segment.

variables.label: Loop duration
variables.description: Seconds for one pass along each line.
